# IT Resource Zone

> Online learning and exam portal for beginner IT students, with live exams, practice exams, leaderboards, study planning, and curated learning resources.

- **Developer:** Atif Hasan
- **Live URL:** https://irz.atifhasan.com
- **Stack:** Next.js 15, MongoDB Atlas, Clerk Auth, Vercel

## What This App Does

IT Resource Zone helps IT students prepare with:

- Registered student accounts for live and practice exams
- Timed exam attempts, secure answer locking, and instant scoring
- Public per-exam and global leaderboards
- A curated resource library with YouTube lessons, PDFs, files, and useful links
- Personal study planning, habit tracking, and progress analytics

## Key Public Pages

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/` | Home page |
| `/exams` | Published live, upcoming, and past exams |
| `/exam/[id]` | Public exam overview and signed-in exam entry |
| `/resources` | Curated IT learning resource library |
| `/resources/[slug]` | Resource category page |
| `/resources/watch/[slug]` | Public video lesson page |
| `/leaderboard` | Global leaderboard |
| `/leaderboard/[id]` | Per-exam leaderboard |
| `/privacy` | Privacy Policy |
| `/terms` | Terms of Service |

## Private Or Non-Indexable Areas

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/profile` | Student profile and submission history |
| `/tasks` | Personal study planner |
| `/tasks/history` | Personal study analytics |
| `/admin` | Private admin panel |
| `/api/*` | API routes |

## Rules

- Live exams can enforce one submission per student account.
- Answers are locked once selected.
- Live exam questions are protected until an authorized attempt begins.
- Student data is private; only public leaderboard information is intended for indexing.
